Short title and commencement

ACT XXXII OF 2012
ACT XXXII OF 2012
BANK OF PUNJAB (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2012
An Act further to amend the Bank of Punjab
Act, 1989 (XII of 1989)
[Gazette of Punjab, Extraordinary
16th March, 2012]
No.PAP-Legis-2(114)/2011/567,
dated 16-3-2012.---The Bank of Punjab (Amendment) Bill 2011, having been passed
by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab on 7 March 2012, and assented to by
the Governor of the Punjab on 15 March 2012, is hereby published as an Act of
the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab.
Preamble.---Whereas it
is expedient further to amend the Bank of Punjab Act, 1989 (XII of 1989) for
purposes hereinafter appearing;
It is enacted as follows:---
1. Short title and
commencement.---(1) This Act may be cited as the Bank of Punjab
(Amendment) Act, 2012
(2) It shall come into force
at once

Substitution of section 7 of Act XII of 1989

the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab.
Preamble.---Whereas it
is expedient further to amend the Bank of Punjab Act, 1989 (XII of 1989) for
purposes hereinafter appearing;
It is enacted as follows:---
2. Substitution of section 7
of Act XII of 1989.---In the Bank of Punjab Act, 1989 (XII of 1989), for
section 7 the following shall be substituted:---
"7. Government to be
share-holder.---Notwithstanding anything contained in
section 6, the Government shall be the share-holder of the Bank and may hold upto eighty per cent of the shares issued by the
Bank,"
